status: analysis exploration lock; not a model; no version assigned
raceFeatures: JRA win-market entropy and top1/top2/top3 concentration
model-vs-market KL divergence, maximum/minimum/std horse edge, count of positive-edge horses, longshot-edge summaries
official quinella market concentration, entropy, odds quantiles and overround
raceTarget: log1p(actual JRA quinella payout per 100 yen / 100), learned only after the race date is fully finished
raceSelection: exactly five highest predicted surprise races per raceDate x venue; never fewer

fixedLightPortfolio.win: 100 yen on highest OOS win value score horse
fixedLightPortfolio.wide: 100 yen on highest fixed pair value score
fixedLightPortfolio.quinella: remaining 1800 yen as 200 yen on each of top nine distinct fixed pair-value tickets
fixedLightPortfolio.pairValueScore: official pair market log-probability + 1.5*(sum of two horse log OOS/model-market edges) + 0.5*log official odds
fixedLightPortfolio.winValueScore: log OOS win probability + 0.75*log official win odds
